text: Veil brings private receiving to NEAR named accounts. Keep one readable name, while every payment goes to a fresh address.
shot: Public URL and testnet badge; show registry2/router2. No Vercel login screen.

text: First, connect a testnet wallet and choose Derive keys. Approve the message in your wallet. Veil derives viewing and spending keys in this browser. Keep the same wallet signing key.
shot: Recipient window: Connect wallet, Derive keys, NEP-413 approval, confirmation. Hide wallet recovery screens.

text: Register name publishes the two public keys. Approve the registry transaction, then resolve the name. Senders can now look up this reusable identity.
shot: Recipient: Register name; approve 0.01 NEAR storage deposit; wait for confirmation; Resolve the actual account.

text: In a separate sender window, enter that name and send a small testnet payment. The browser derives a new implicit account and asks the wallet to approve the router call. The result shows the one-time destination.
shot: Separate sender profile: connect, enter recipient and 0.01 NEAR, Send privately, approve router2, show destination/receipt. Keep recipient tab open.

text: Back in the recipient window, Scan checks the public announcements with the private viewing key. The matching payment appears with its balance. Other people's announcements stay outside this inbox.
shot: After finality, recipient clicks Scan. Show real owned account and balance; retain receipt/hash separately.

text: Choose Spend to send a small amount from that stealth account. Read the warning: sending to your named account creates a public link. Confirm, then check the successful transaction receipt.
shot: Recipient: Spend; record re-link confirmation for 0.001 NEAR to connected account; show result hash and NearBlocks receipt.

text: Copy the view key and open a separate auditor window. Paste it into the masked field and scan the registered name. The auditor sees incoming payments, with no spending key or spend control.
shot: Copy view key; separate unsigned context: paste in password field, enter name, Scan as auditor. Never unmask or record clipboard contents.

text: Recorded Sputnik DAO evidence shows council approval of a private router payout, and the recipient scanner finding that payment.
shot: Show committed DAO JSON PASS, DAO ID, scan.found=1 and NearBlocks approval. Label: previously recorded DAO evidence.

text: Testnet only. Amounts, timing and senders remain public. Combining balances reveals links.
shot: Hold final app/limits card through end; keep complete last sentence audible.
